lines.t: Your nation's heart is hardened
Gone the way of the wicked and heathen
The churches of men still cry out
But their voices ring hollow and beaten
Sodom's shadows rise again
The fires burn within your borders
And I look upon this land of grief
Still holding back my orders
For the sake of the chosen few
I linger in the silence
Holding back the storm
Restraining holy violence
Oh mighty nation
Can you hear the thunder's warning cry
You were blessed beyond the stars
Now your glory starts to die
I am against you
Cries the Lord of sorrow and flame
You're all so strained in blasphemy
You've forgotten His name
I made you strong, I gave you life
Blessings beyond compare
Yet you bow to golden pride
Your praise is filled with despair
The lamb was beaten, mocked and torn
Crucified to save your soul
But now his blood is trampled down
Your darkness takes its toll
Desecration, blasphemy
Echoes through your streets
His mercy still restrains
The wrath that justice longs to meet
How the heavens weep for you, a harlot clothed in shame
The trumpet waits in silence to call the elect by name
O mighty nation, crumble to your knees and sing
The tears of heaven falling for lost eternity
For I am against you
Yet my hand still holds the day
Until the chosen rise
And the faithful are taken away
Your nation's heart has fallen
Your glory turned to dust
The word of the Lord stands forever
And he remembers those who trust.
